title: 第22章 圣路狩猎即将开始第23章 四家聚宴
content_zh:
“冰儿，邪帝呢？”陈纵横已经带着陈家年轻一代在家门口处。
冰帝缓步而来。
“还在睡觉。”冰帝一想到昨晚听着邪帝和魅影厮混的声音睡着就有点难绷，今早要去叫邪帝，居然还不让她进，门口有个结界！
“这臭小子，那我们先过去吧。”陈纵横说罢领着冰帝，炎君，陈雨薇，天心，陈宇萧（陈纵横二弟的儿子），陈语晴（陈纵横三弟的女儿）陈家没有旁系，小辈就这么多，那么多家族，陈家人最少。
会议还未开始，可各家族及城主已经全部到齐了，各方天骄也聚在一起讨论修行。
姚晨昏也已经在王位上了，公主圣君，王子姚星耀，皇后月寻坐在一旁。
“第一次亲眼看见公主殿下，好美啊！简直就是仙子呐！”
“哈哈哈哈哈哈，前几日我可跟公主殿下一起对抗过陨石雨呢！羡慕吧！”
“王子殿下真年轻啊。”
“以后会是继承王位的会是谁啊？”
“肯定是公主啊，公主可是天赐之名的帝君，必会带着我们九天神国重回巅峰的。”
台下议论纷纷，台上姚晨昏看着其乐融融的场面很是高兴。
另一边，长者，魔，醉酒仙人，左道手四位神境巅峰也在，在下方，皇室骑士团13位与星之队7位也全都在！
各家都心头震惊，这场面够大啊。
陈家、顾家和盛家在一起聊着天。
“炎君，邪帝呢？”顾千言问道。
“哥哥还在睡觉。”
“那他不来嘛？”顾千言眼神中有丝失望。
“不知道诶。”
“丫头，那么想邪帝啊，怎么不见你来我们家玩啊？”

“陈叔叔，你说什么呢！”顾千言羞红了脸，偷偷瞄了眼冰帝，冰帝跟女帝在一起看手机。
“哈哈哈哈。”顾辞笑道，“那等会去你们家作客。上次邪帝贤侄救我女儿一命还没表示呢。”
“哎呀，什么话。没必要表示，那小子应该做的。”陈纵横笑道。
“不行不行，我们必须好好喝一杯。”
“那多加我一个吧。陈兄，炎君跟女帝的婚宴怕是没咯。”
“爸爸！”女帝听到婚宴俩字特别敏感。
神君笑着摇了摇头，想打电话给邪帝，发现关机了。
“哈哈哈哈，到点了，大家都聊的差不多了，那我来讲两件事......”姚晨昏爽朗的笑声响起，众人停下讨论，准备洗耳恭听。
可姚晨昏讲到一半，九天圣殿的大门被人推开了，打断了姚晨昏接下来要说的话。
众人向门口望去，谁啊，现在进来，这不找死嘛？
邪帝推开大门，打着哈欠，手里拿着根棒棒糖，打完哈欠后，将棒棒糖塞进了嘴里，“没来......哈欠......迟吧，好困啊，肚子好饿。”邪帝揉着眼睛，走进九天圣殿。
“这家伙是哪里的天骄，这不低能儿嘛？”
“这不打陛下的脸啊？”
“呵，今天太阳从西边出来？没踹门。”长者看着来人，洪亮的声音响起，打断了下方的议论。
“没办法，太困了。早啊，师傅、魔、老东西。”老东西？叫谁老东西啊？
“尊重我点，我可是圣君的爷爷！”叫老国君老东西？！
“早什么早，这都几点了。”魔捂脸。
“哈哈哈哈哈，在以前，你起那么晚，你师娘早就打你了。”醉酒仙人笑道。
“屁，打的明明是你。”
content_en:
"Bing'er, where is the Evil Emperor?" Chen Zongheng was already leading the younger generation of the Chen family at the door of the house.
The Ice Emperor came slowly.
"Still sleeping." The Ice Emperor found it a little hard to fall asleep when he thought about the sound of the Evil Emperor and the Phantom messing around last night. He was going to call the Evil Emperor this morning, but he wouldn't let her in. There was a barrier at the door!
"This brat, let's go over first." Chen Zongheng said and led Ice Emperor, Yan Jun, Chen Yuwei, Tianxin, Chen Yuxiao (son of Chen Zongheng's second brother), and Chen Yuqing (daughter of Chen Zongheng's third brother). The Chen family has no side branches, and there are only so many juniors. There are so many families, and the Chen family is the least.
The meeting hasn't started yet, but all the families and city lords have already arrived, and the geniuses from all over the world have also gathered to discuss cultivation.
Yao Chenwen was already on the throne, with Princess Shengjun, Prince Yao Xingyao, and Queen Yuexun sitting aside.
"This is the first time I see Her Royal Highness with my own eyes. She is so beautiful! She looks like a fairy!"
"Hahahahahaha, a few days ago I fought against the meteorite rain with Her Royal Highness the Princess! You must be envious!"
"Your Highness the Prince is so young."
"Who will inherit the throne in the future?"
"She must be the princess. The princess is a God-given emperor. She will definitely lead our Nine Heavens Divine Kingdom back to its peak."
There was a lot of discussion in the audience, and Yao Chenhun was very happy to see the happy scene on the stage.
On the other side, the four peak gods of the Elder, the Demon, the Drunken Immortal, and the Left Hand are also there. Below, the 13 members of the Royal Knights and the 7 members of the Star Team are also there!
Everyone was shocked, this scene was big enough.
The Chen family, Gu family and Sheng family were chatting together.
"Master Yan, where is the Evil Emperor?" Gu Qianyan asked.
"Brother is still sleeping."
"Then he won't come?" Gu Qianyan had a hint of disappointment in his eyes.
"I don't know."
"Girl, I miss the Evil Emperor so much, why don't you come to our house to play?"
"Uncle Chen, what are you talking about!" Gu Qianyan blushed and secretly glanced at the Ice Emperor, who was looking at his cell phone with the Empress.
"Hahahaha." Gu Ci said with a smile, "I'll be a guest at your house later. The evil emperor's nephew saved my daughter's life last time and he didn't say anything yet."
"Oh, what are you talking about? There is no need to express it, that kid should do it." Chen Zongheng laughed.
"No, no, we have to have a drink."
"Then add me as an extra person. Brother Chen, I'm afraid there won't be a wedding banquet for Lord Yan and the Empress."
"Dad!" The empress was particularly sensitive to the word wedding.
The Lord Shen smiled and shook his head. He wanted to call the Evil Emperor, but found that his phone was turned off.
"Hahahaha, it's time, everyone has almost finished talking, let me tell you two things..." Yao Chenhun's hearty laughter sounded, and everyone stopped the discussion and prepared to listen.
But halfway through Yao Chenwen's speech, the door of Jiutian Temple was pushed open, interrupting Yao Chenwen's next words.
Everyone looked at the door, who is it? Come in now, aren't you looking for death?
The Evil Emperor pushed open the door, yawned, and held a lollipop in his hand. After yawning, he stuffed the lollipop into his mouth, "No...yawn...it's too late, I'm so sleepy, and I'm so hungry." The Evil Emperor rubbed his eyes and walked into the Nine Heavens Temple.
"Who is this guy's genius? Isn't he a moron?"
"Isn't this a slap in His Majesty's face?"
"Oh, the sun comes out from the west today? You didn't kick the door open." The elder looked at the visitor, and his loud voice sounded, interrupting the discussion below.
"No way, I'm too sleepy. Good morning, master, demon, old thing." Old thing? Who are you calling an old guy?
"Respect me, I am the grandpa of the Holy Lord!" Calling the old monarch an old thing? !
"How early is it? What time is it?" Mo covered his face.
"Hahahahaha, in the past, if you got up so late, your wife would have beaten you long ago." The Drunken Immortal laughed.
"Shit, it's obviously you who got hit."
